tool.name: ExportFeaturesToFolder

param.name: in_features
param.dialogReference: The layer or feature class to export. If the layer has a selection, only the selected features are exported.

param.name: where_clause
param.dialogReference: An SQL expression built from the fields of Input Features, for example VOLTAGE >= 230. Only the matching features are exported. Leave it empty to export every feature.

param.name: out_folder
param.dialogReference: The folder that receives the output. The File Geodatabase format writes into Exports.gdb in this folder and creates it if needed.

param.name: out_format
param.dialogReference:
• GeoJSON: a .geojson file in WGS84 longitude and latitude (Features To JSON, Output to GeoJSON, Project to WGS84). This is the default.

  • Shapefile: a .shp file (Export Features). Field names longer than 10 characters are shortened.

  • CSV: a .csv table of the attributes only, without the shapes (Export Table).

  • File Geodatabase: a feature class in Exports.gdb (Export Features).

param.name: out_name
param.dialogReference: The output name without an extension. The dialog suggests the input name; if it is empty the input name is used. Invalid characters are replaced with underscores.

param.name: out_path
param.dialogReference: The full path of the file or feature class the tool wrote, so the result can feed another tool or a model.

tool.summary: Exports the features of a layer, all of them or only those that match an expression, to a folder as GeoJSON, a shapefile, a CSV table or a feature class in a file geodatabase.
tool.usage:
• Every format exports the same features: the expression is applied once with Make Feature Layer, and Get Count reports the number in the messages.

  • An expression that matches no features gives a warning and an empty output.

  • An existing output with the same name is replaced only when the geoprocessing option to overwrite outputs is on.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: Export a layer, or a subset of it, to GeoJSON, shapefile, CSV or a file geodatabase.
